narr: Scattered thunderstorms developed during the heat of the day ahead of a cold front. One of these storms produced a damaging microburst, and another caused flash flooding of roads. The cold front trailed southwest from a low pressure center over the Great Lakes region across northern Illinois and central Missouri.
ev: Significant flash flooding was reported in the Madisonville area. Flooding was reported over a portion of Interstate 69 at exit 116. Flooding in town resulted in one stalled vehicle.
